column_descriptions.rna_id: Identifier of the regulatory non-coding RNA (miRBase ID, HGNC symbol for lncRNA, circRNA ID)
column_descriptions.rna_type: Molecular class of the regulatory RNA (miRNA, lncRNA, circRNA)
column_descriptions.target_gene: HGNC gene symbol of the regulated gene/mRNA target
column_descriptions.evidence: Confidence or validation level of the interaction (validated vs predicted)
column_descriptions.source_db: Curated database repository providing the interaction tuple

identifier_schemes.lncRNA: HGNC gene symbols (e.g., HOTAIR, MALAT1, H19)
identifier_schemes.circRNA: circBase identifiers (e.g., hsa_circ_0001649) and alias symbols (ciRS-7)
identifier_schemes.target_gene: Standard uppercase HGNC human gene symbols (e.g., TNF, TP53, PTEN)

provenance_and_metadata.collection_method: Hand-curated prototype sample dataset bundled for local demonstration and testing
provenance_and_metadata.database_releases: Unspecified in repository (upstream versions for miRTarBase, starBase, LncRNA2Target, CircInteractome not tracked)
provenance_and_metadata.organism_annotation: Implicitly human (Homo sapiens / hsa) via hsa- prefixes and HGNC symbols, no organism column present
